reading.body:
The operator's own page for Flexential Denver - Downtown publishes one figure: 759,000 square feet of technical space. No IT load in megawatts, no critical power figure, and no redundancy tier are published on that page, so none can be stated here. Without a power figure, no conversion to rack count or accelerator density is possible for this campus.

The certifications section of the spec page is empty, meaning no compliance or uptime certification is published for this facility. That absence does not mean certifications do not exist, only that none appear in the structured facts this site has read.

Colorado has 17 mapped facilities in this site's dataset, and only one of those publishes a megawatt figure, totaling 18 MW across the state. This campus ranks second by published megawatts in the state, but because its own published megawatt figure is not available, that ranking is derived from the state-level dataset structure rather than from a number attached to this campus directly. Denver - Downtown is a large facility by floor area, but its significance to AI workloads cannot be assessed from published specifications alone.
